draft: This is general information regarding your situation with the ongoing land dispute case at the Allahabad Civil Court. Since your case has been pending for eight years, you can track its progress independently using the eCourts Services website or mobile app. By entering your 16-character CNR number, you can view the next hearing date, previous orders, and the current status of the proceedings. If you do not have the CNR number, you can search by selecting the court complex, case type, case number, and year. Regarding your concerns about unresponsive legal counsel and financial constraints, you may approach the District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) in Allahabad. Under the Legal Services Authorities Act, free legal aid is provided to eligible persons, which includes women and members of Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes. You can contact the DLSA helpline at 15100 to inquire about obtaining a free lawyer to represent you. It is advisable to keep all your case-related documents, such as previous orders and notices, organized and ready for review by a legal aid panel lawyer. Additionally, you may inquire with the court or your legal aid representative about the possibility of resolving the matter through Lok Adalat or mediation, which are alternative methods designed to settle disputes outside of the formal trial process.

You can contact the DLSA helpline at 15100 to inquire about obtaining a free lawyer to represent you. # Information regarding your pending civil case and legal aid options

Aapka case Allahabad Civil Court mein pending hai, jise aap eCourts website par CNR number daal kar check kar sakte hain. Kyunki aap mahila hain aur ST category se hain, aap District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) se free legal aid aur lawyer ke liye apply kar sakti hain. Aap 15100 helpline par call karke madad le sakti hain aur apne documents taiyaar rakhein.

## Where to get help
1. **District Legal Services Authority (DLSA)** (DLSA office at your district court · NALSA legal-aid helpline) — First. Free legal advice, and a free lawyer if you are eligible; DLSA also runs Lok Adalats for settling disputes without a trial. https://nalsa.gov.in · 15100
2. **eCourts case status** (eCourts Services website / app) — If you already have a case: check its status, next hearing date and orders with the 16-character CNR number, or with the court, case type, number and year. https://services.ecourts.gov.in

_Information, not legal advice._
